newsitem.title: USA: ChemTrak to unveil colorectal cancer test.
newsitem.headline: ChemTrak to unveil colorectal cancer test.

text.p: ChemTrak Inc said it plans to unveil soon a home test for the early detection of colorectal disease in the U.S. called ColoCARE.
In a statement, ChemTrak said ColoCARE, which is noninvasiveand sanitary, received Food and Drug Administration clearance tobe marketed and will soon be available in the U.S.
ChemTrak said the test will retail for less than $7 and will be marketed with ChemTrak's other home personal diagnostic products.
The company said colorectal cancer claims 55,000 lives in the United States each year.
